props.text: Waxing removes hair from the root, so skin stays smooth for longer than after shaving. We use olive oil strip wax for larger areas such as arms, legs and back, and Mancine Strawberry Hard Wax for delicate areas such as a Brazilian.

items.question: How long do waxing results last?
items.answer: Waxing results can last several weeks, depending on your natural hair growth cycle, because waxing removes hair from the root and keeps skin smoother for longer than shaving. With regular sessions, many guests notice hair grows back softer and finer over time.

items.question: Is waxing painful?
items.answer: Waxing may feel slightly uncomfortable, especially during the first session, but professional techniques and suitable wax products help make it more comfortable. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, we use Mancine Strawberry Hard Wax for delicate areas and olive oil strip wax for larger areas, adjust technique to your skin sensitivity and check your comfort throughout.

items.question: Should I shave before my waxing appointment?
items.answer: No. You do not need to shave before waxing at Spa Bali Moon. Hair should be long enough for the wax to grip properly, usually about 6 mm (¼ inch). Your therapist prepares the skin before waxing and gives aftercare guidance afterwards.

items.question: Do you offer Brazilian waxing?
items.answer: Yes. Brazilian waxing at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 375.000 and is done in a private treatment setting with careful techniques to maintain comfort and discretion. For delicate areas we use Mancine Strawberry Hard Wax, and your therapist checks your comfort throughout.

items.question: What should I avoid after waxing?
items.answer: After waxing, avoid hot showers, intense sun exposure and strong exfoliation for a short period so the skin can remain calm. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, your therapist finishes every waxing treatment with simple aftercare instructions.

items.question: Is waxing suitable for men?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak provides waxing options for men, such as the back and full back, with techniques adjusted for comfort and skin sensitivity. Full back waxing is IDR 419.000 and stomach (strip) waxing IDR 159.000. Treatments take place in a private setting at our spa, or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: How much does waxing cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: Waxing at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 99.000 for eyebrows or upper lip, IDR 159.000 for under arms or a stomach strip, IDR 189.000 for half arms, IDR 229.000 for full arms, IDR 249.000 for half legs, IDR 285.000 for a bikini wax, IDR 349.000 for full legs, IDR 375.000 for a Brazilian and IDR 419.000 for a full back. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: How long does a waxing appointment take?
items.answer: A waxing appointment at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes around an hour, depending on the areas you choose. Prices start at IDR 99.000 for eyebrows or upper lip, and a Brazilian wax is IDR 375.000.

items.question: Can I have waxing done at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with everything waxing needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book waxing for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my waxing?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your wax on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
